'''Anush Begloian''' ({{langx|hy|Անուշ Բեղլոյան}}; born 31 July 1969) is an Armenian physicist and politician of the [[Civil Contract (Armenia)|Civil Contract]]. Since the [[2018 Armenian parliamentary election|Parliamentary Election in 2018]], she has been a member of the [[National Assembly (Armenia)|National Assembly of Armenia]].

== Education ==
Anush Begloian was born and raised in [[Yerevan]], [[Armenian Soviet Socialist Republic|Soviet Armenia]]. She studied physics at the [[Yerevan State University]] from where she graduated in 1991, and obtained an [[Master of Business Administration|MBA]] from the [[American University of Armenia]] in Yerevan in 1995.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|title=National Assembly of Armenia|url=http://www.parliament.am/deputies.php?ID=1285&lang=eng&sel=details|url-status=live|access-date=2021-08-09|website=[[National Assembly of Armenia]]|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210128051905/http://www.parliament.am/deputies.php?ID=1285&lang=eng&sel=details |archive-date=2021-01-28 }}</ref>

== Professional career ==
Throughout her career, she was employed by various foreign and international entities such as the [[United States Agency for International Development]] (USAID), the [[World Bank]] and the [[United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees]].<ref name=":0" /> She specialized in public relations and communications was the executive director of the NGO Armenian Public Relations Association between 2003 and 2009.<ref name=":0" /> Between 2005 and 2009 she also lectured on Business Communication and Public relations at the [[Fondation Université Française en Arménie|University of France in Armenia]].<ref name=":0" /> In 2008 she took a hold in the private sector and was “[[ArmenTel]]” CJSC's head of public relations until 2014.<ref name=":0" /> In 2016 she returned as a lecturer to the University of France in Armenia.<ref name=":0" />

== Political career ==
Before she was elected to the National Assembly of Armenia as Member of Parliament of the Civil Contract over the My Step Alliance in December 2018, she was a consultant to the Chief of Staff of the Armenian Parliament.<ref name=":0" /> In Parliament she is a member in the [[Armenian-Lithuanian relations|Armenian-Lithuanian]]<ref>{{Cite web|date=11 May 2021|title=Delegation led by NA Speaker Ararat Mirzoyan leaves for Lithuania on an official visit|url=https://www.aravot-en.am/2021/05/11/282626/|url-status=live|access-date=9 August 2021|website=[[Aravot]]|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210809212113/https://www.aravot-en.am/2021/05/11/282626/ |archive-date=2021-08-09 }}</ref> and the [[Armenia–United Kingdom relations|Armenian-British]] Friendship Group.<ref>{{Cite web|date=3 December 2019|title=Issues on development of Armenian-British relations discussed|url=https://www.aravot-en.am/2019/12/03/246272/|url-status=live|access-date=9 August 2021|website=[[Aravot]]|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191204142659/https://www.aravot-en.am/2019/12/03/246272/ |archive-date=2019-12-04 }}</ref> In November 2019 she assumed as the vice-president of the ''Parliamentary Assembly of the Black Sea Economic Cooperation'' a post for which she was elected for one year.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Armenian MP elected PABSEC Vice-President|url=https://armenpress.am/eng/news/996587|access-date=2021-08-09|website=armenpress.am|language=en}}</ref>

== Personal life ==
Anush Begloian is married and has two children.<ref>{{Cite web|title=National Delegations|url=https://www.pabsec.org/national-delegations.asp?hl=en|url-status=live|access-date=2021-08-09|website=www.pabsec.org|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161107071559/http://pabsec.org/national-delegations.asp?hl=en |archive-date=2016-11-07 }}</ref>
